hook: Spacecraft reaches Mercury on second-ever mission to enter its orbit
hookText: Spacecraft reaches Mercury on second-ever mission to enter its orbit

beats.say: The BepiColombo spacecraft has arrived at Mercury, only the second mission ever to enter orbit around the innermost planet.

For researchers, the €1.6bn mission is the best hope yet of understanding how Mercury formed so close to the sun, why it has a magnetic field, and what makes up the frozen ice that lurks in the planet’s permanently shadowed craters.
Mercury is only 50% larger than the moon but has four times its mass.
